About

A specialist, not a marketplace.

System.aero has been run from Kraków, Poland since 2018. Every product in our range exists because a plant engineer needed it to work. We work in Polish, English and Ukrainian.

Questions? Answers.

Frequently asked

What does System.aero supply?

System.aero is a Kraków-based supplier of industrial consumables for surface protection and finishing: protective covers for painting robots, masking tapes, tack cloths and technical wipes, polishing systems, transport dunnage, and aerospace chemistry.

Which industries do you serve?

Automotive OEM and tier-1 paintshops, aerospace MRO and military aviation facilities, and general industrial painting operations.

Do you supply automotive OEM plants?

Yes. System.aero is a registered supplier to major automotive OEMs and delivers to paintshops in Poland and Europe.

Can I test products before ordering?

Yes — we ship free samples of consumables (wipes, tack cloths, tapes, robot covers, sanding discs) and support on-site trials.

Do you deliver outside Poland?

Yes. We deliver to plants across Europe and quote worldwide.

Take the next step.

Request free samples — test our consumables in your own process, shipped worldwide. Or send photos and drawings to discuss a custom project.
